records.text: Our operating revenue increased $10.7 million, or 3.7%, in the first three months of 2023 from the first three months of 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our Brokerage segment develops contractual relationships with and arranges for third-party carriers to transport freight for our customers in temperature-controlled trailers and dry vans within the United States and into and out of Mexico through Marten Transport Logistics, LLC, which was established in 2007 and operates pursuant to brokerage authority granted by the DOT.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: In addition to the factors discussed above, our operating revenue is also affected by, among other things, the United States economy, inventory levels, the level of truck and rail capacity in the transportation market, a contracting driver market, severe weather conditions and specific customer demand.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our profitability is impacted by the variable costs of transporting freight for our customers, fixed costs, and expenses containing both fixed and variable components.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our operating income declined 19.1% to $29.0 million in the first three months of 2023 from $35.9 million in the first three months of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total revenue for the first quarter of 2023 decreased by $24.5 million to $492.7 million as compared to the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Tractors are operated with a solo driver or, when handling more time-sensitive, higher-margin freight, a team of two drivers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our total operating revenue is affected by certain factors that relate to, among other things, the general level of economic activity in the United States, customer inventory levels, specific customer demand, the level of capacity in the truckload and brokerage industry, the success of our marketing and sales efforts and the availability of drivers, independent contractors and third-party carriers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the first quarter of 2023, the Company incurred approximately $3.0 million of Merger related costs that are recorded in general and other operating expenses within the unaudited condensed consolidated statements of comprehensive income (loss).

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating loss for the first quarter of 2023 was $29.9 million compared to operating loss of $0.2 million in the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue decreased by 0.1 percent in the first quarter of 2023 compared to the same period in 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease resulted primarily from decreases in shipments and tonnage, partially offset by increased revenue per shipment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) was 85.0 percent in the first quarter of 2023 compared to 84.4 percent in the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue per shipment increased 7.6 percent to $354.37 per shipment for the first quarter of 2023 as a result of changes in business mix and pricing actions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $99.1 million for the first quarter of 2023 compared to $103.4 million for the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Enterprise operating revenues decreased $191.8 million, approximately 12%, in the first quarter of 2023 compared to the same quarter in 2022.
